verdict.rationale: Sunbiz publishes a numbered, step-by-step 'start a business' guide (e.g. 'Step 2: Identify Your Type of Business — Decide on a Corporate Structure', 'Step 4: Register Your Business Name (Optional)'). Its annual-report page explains in plain language what can be changed, how to pay, how to reprint vouchers, how reinstatement works and what happens after posting, with a Spanish-language option. That is guidance a non-lawyer can follow, not just form numbers. Missing for 10: evidence of the depth of the explainers (e.g. what each corporate structure means or its trade-offs), full coverage of steps 1 and 3 of the start-business guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration that founders find the guidance usable.
